nodes.description: Public token name string of UniswapExchange, set once in the constructor.
Public token symbol string of UniswapExchange, set once in the constructor.
Public total token supply, minted to the owner in the constructor and never burned.
Private privileged address; used as the whitelist bypass in ensure() and as the only auth check for delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of holder balances; written by constructor, transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount; written by constructor, approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping counting how many times an address has sold; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Private mapping that whitelists addresses allowed to sell in ensure().
Private minimum sale amount set by init() and enforced by condition().
Private maximum sale amount set by init() and enforced by condition().
Private per-address sale count limit set by init() and enforced by condition().
Private address set by setTradeAddress() and used as an extra whitelist bypass in ensure().
Public constant decimals = 18, used to scale supply and sale limits.
Hardcoded constant Uniswap V2 Router address used as a whitelist bypass in ensure().
Payable constructor: mints the entire supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view guard implementing the honeypot whitelist: owner, UNI, computed pair and tradeAddress can sell freely, everyone else must pass condition().
Public payable transferFrom with allowance handling and the ensure() gate; performs unguarded balance arithmetic and increment of _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with _value.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale limits; returns false when all limits are zero.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
Owner-only initializer of the sale configuration variables _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow checks and emits two half-value Transfer events per recipient.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address computation using CREATE2 init-code hash hashing.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership, allowance and whitelist decisions throughout the contract.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the owner, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed with native 0.5.17 arithmetic, i.e. without SafeMath.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow checking in batchSend.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Sender address parameter of ensure(), compared against the whitelist.
Recipient address parameter of ensure(), compared against owner.
Amount parameter of ensure(), forwarded to condition().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom(); drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Address parameter of condition(), used to index _onSaleNum.
Amount parameter of condition(), compared with _minSale and _maxSale.
Target address parameter of delegate(), used as delegatecall target.
Raw calldata parameter of delegate(), executed via delegatecall.
Per-address sale count limit parameter of init(), assigned to _saleNum.
Minimum sale amount parameter of init(), scaled by decimals into _minSale.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init(), scaled by decimals into _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend().
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend().
Address parameter of setTradeAddress(), stored into tradeAddress.
Uniswap factory address parameter of pairFor().
First token address parameter of pairFor().
Second token address parameter of pairFor().
Local variable holding the computed Uniswap pair address used in the ensure() whitelist check.
Local variable holding _value * _tos.length in batchSend().
Loop-local recipient address copied from _tos[i] in batchSend().
Token name constructor parameter.
Token symbol constructor parameter.
Initial supply constructor parameter, scaled by decimals.

edges.reason: _to recipient flows into transfer().
_value amount flows into transfer().
_from is used by ensure() to decide whether the sender is whitelisted.
_to is compared against owner inside ensure().
_value is forwarded from ensure() into condition().
_from source address flows into transferFrom().
_to destination address flows into transferFrom().
_value drives the allowance and balance subtractions in transferFrom().
_spender flows into approve().
_value is written into the allowance mapping by approve().
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
_value is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
Delegate target address is fully caller-controlled.
Delegate calldata flows into delegate().
saleNum flows into _saleNum in init().
token flows into _minSale in init().
maxToken flows into _maxSale in init().
_tos array is iterated in batchSend().
_value is multiplied by _tos.length in batchSend().
addr becomes the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
factory address flows into the CREATE2 computation.
tokenA is sorted and hashed in pairFor().
tokenB is sorted and hashed in pairFor().
_name initializes the name state variable.
_symbol initializes the symbol state variable.
_supply is scaled by 10**decimals to mint the total supply.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire minted supply.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument by transfer().
msg.sender controls the allowance branch and the ensure() gate.
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() as a sale gate before moving balances.
ensure() calls condition() to enforce the sale limits.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the Uniswap pair whitelist address.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address.
The caller-supplied address a is the delegatecall target.
The caller-supplied bytes b is the delegatecall payload.
transferFrom() updates balances with unchecked 0.5.17 arithmetic.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply to _supply*10**decimals.
Constructor stores msg.sender as the privileged owner.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router.
transferFrom() decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sale.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
init() reads the decimals constant to scale the sale limits.
batchSend() deducts a total from the owner balance and credits each recipient.
setTradeAddress() stores a new whitelist bypass address in tradeAddress.
ensure() reads owner to unconditionally allow the owner to sell.
ensure() reads canSale to whitelist sellers.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as an additional whitelist bypass.
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI constant.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() reads _minSale as a lower bound.
condition() reads _maxSale as an upper bound.
condition() reads _saleNum to limit the number of sales.
Each recipient from _tos is copied into the loop-local _to.
_UNI local holds the pairFor result used by ensure().
total local holds the unchecked product computed in batchSend().
_to loop-local is credited inside batchSend().

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to of transfer() is only meaningful as an input to that core function.
Parameter _value of transfer() is only meaningful as an input to that core function.
Parameter _from of ensure() is only meaningful inside the ensure gate.
Parameter _to of ensure() is only meaningful inside the ensure gate.
Parameter _value of ensure() flows into condition() invoked by ensure.
Parameter _from of transferFrom() is only meaningful inside that core function.
Parameter _to of transferFrom() is only meaningful inside that core function.
Parameter _value of transferFrom() drives the unsafe balance arithmetic there.
Parameter _spender of approve() is only meaningful inside that core function.
Parameter _value of approve() is written to the allowance mapping in that core function.
Parameter _from of condition() is only meaningful inside the condition check.
Parameter _value of condition() is only meaningful inside the condition check.
Delegate target parameter is an input to the delegate() function that performs the unsafe delegatecall.
Delegate payload parameter is an input to the delegate() function that performs the unsafe delegatecall.
saleNum parameter is only meaningful inside init().
token parameter is only meaningful inside init().
maxToken parameter is only meaningful inside init().
_tos array parameter is only iterated inside batchSend().
_value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
addr parameter is only meaningful as the input of setTradeAddress().
factory parameter is only used inside pairFor().
tokenA parameter is only used inside pairFor().
tokenB parameter is only used inside pairFor().
Local _UNI exists only to hold the pairFor result consumed by ensure().
Local total exists only inside batchSend() and is tied to its unchecked multiplication.
Loop-local _to exists only inside the batchSend() iteration.
Constructor parameter _name is only meaningful inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter _symbol is only meaningful inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter _supply is only meaningful inside the constructor.
